notes.title: ⚔️ Update 0.3.3 — “Centurion’s Honor” ⚔️ Live Now!
notes.notes:
[p]Centurions! The march continues with [b]update 0.3.3[/b], bringing new layers of [b]strategy, fresh content, and quality-of-life improvements[/b] to your campaigns. This patch expands both the battlefield and the camp, giving you more control over your legion and its daily life.[/p][hr][/hr][h2]🆕 New Content[/h2][list][*][p][b]Customizable Shortcuts[/b]
Take full command of your orders! You can now reassign shortcuts (F1–F5) with any order from the command menu.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Camp Management Interface[/b]
The heart of your expedition just got an upgrade. Manage every detail of your camp with new features:[/p][list][*][p]Swap characters between contubernia.[/p][/*][*][p]Decide which equipment each soldier picks up.[/p][/*][*][p]View camp summaries at a glance.[/p][/*][*][p]Mark nearby camps on your radar.[/p][/*][*][p]Control a military supply system: view all stored weapons, armor, and tools, and highlight them on the radar.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555144/337c64d3302c58ab900032b079ff0e5db85777e6.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Daily Notifications[/b]
Stay grounded in time — a daily reminder now shows the day, month, year, and season.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fresh Gear[/b][/p][list][*][p]Brand new armors: [b]Lorica Segmentata[/b], historical helmets, and shields.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated visuals for metal objects and chainmail.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Stronger Beginnings[/b]
Your adventure now starts with a seasoned party: 2 evocati, 1 legionary, 1 auxiliary, and 1 servant.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Weapons & Buildings[/b][/p][list][*][p]Two swords and a spear join the [b]Cantabrian arsenal[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]New buildings added for the [b]Vasconian civilization[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555144/c2da89122ae656b7f8981d54b1bee052df5b25fe.jpg"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Camp Variety[/b]
More variants to keep your random camps fresh and unpredictable.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tier 2 Production Table[/b]
Unlock textile crafting and dismantling! Create tunics, cloaks, scarves, accessories, and more.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🔄 Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Seasonal Visuals[/b]
Post-processing and color palettes now shift dynamically with the passing seasons — experience the march of time in a whole new way.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555144/0520b8cb61f745ecd23ba8fc52e2713ef4c2ac50.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Authentic Companions[/b] New models for dogs and cats, that now resemble historical breeds of the era.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjusted Starting Gear[/b][/p][list][*][p]Sword and shield are heavier.[/p][/*][*][p]Start equipped with a Lorica Segmentata and an evocati helmet.[/p][/*][*][p]Your tunic is now dyed in a vivid yellow.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Building Balance[/b]
Resource requirements have been rebalanced across most structures.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed multiple AI combat issues (weapon loops, freezes, etc.).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pet AI problems.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed camp-task AI bugs.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]⚔️ The legions grow stronger with every march. Keep sending your feedback, and together we’ll continue shaping [i]Summa Expeditionis[/i]![/p]

notes.title: 0.3.2 Update Out Now! ⚔️ Combat Rework
notes.notes: [p]Prepare for sharper tactics, smarter allies, and an even more immersive battlefield. This update rebuilds camps from the ground up, adds new tactical tools, and overhauls combat for a more precise and satisfying experience.[/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]🆕 New Content[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Civilization-specific camps[/b] – All enemy, allied, and neutral camps have been rebuilt with unique buildings per civilization. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Fresh defenses[/b] – 3 new Tier 1 defensive towers + 2 access ramps to strengthen your positions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camp overview on HUD[/b] – Always visible inside a camp’s influence area, showing men, food, storage, workload, and more.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Pet status summary[/b] – Keep track of your loyal follower’s health and energy at a glance.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555144/ce1b38bddd8b36491b425fe9778b669f16257c41.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]🔄 Changes & Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]Orders interface redesign[/b] – Reorganized actions, updated visuals, and improved usability.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Contubernium HUD update[/b] – Now perfectly aligned with the new orders system.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Smarter combat logic[/b] – NPCs hold formation, hold position, or charge more strategically—no more random charges.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Advance & hold command[/b] – Move your troops forward 5, 10, or 20 meters, then hold the line.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better camp defense[/b] – Defenders will now man guard posts and take cover when enemies approach fortified camps.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat overhaul[/b] – Control attack direction with mouse movement: high, mid, or low strikes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved ranged combat[/b] –[/p][list][*][p]Javelin/Spear throw camera: faster, more precise.[/p][/*][*][p]Archery camera: zoom for pinpoint accuracy.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Animation & collision polish[/b] – All combat/damage animations updated, hitboxes and collisions reworked for fairness.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555144/d10416451f4ae737681cd6ffa5462f090571d930.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]🐞 Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed multiple issues with resource transfers between storage buildings—NPC logistics are now more efficient.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]💬 [b]Your feedback drives every improvement.[/b] Let us know how the new combat and camp systems feel in the community hub![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.3.1 now available 🛡️ Marching Orders
notes.notes: [p]Salve, centurion ⚔️[/p][p]Surprise, new update just dropped![/p][p]This update lays the groundwork for a more structured and efficient camp life in [i]Summa Expeditionis[/i], introducing key features like batch crafting at the Tier 1 workbench, the addition of the mule cart for logistics, and several new storage options—including officer-specific gear stands and trunks. Players can also explore five new complex recipes in the Tier 2 kitchen, while behind-the-scenes improvements optimize item stacking, NPC behavior, and overall camp performance.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]NEW CONTENT[/b] [/h2][list][*][p]Added a [b]second interaction point[/b] to the [b]Tier 1 workbench[/b] for batch crafting of basic items like torches, sacks, baskets...[/p][/*][*][p]Added the [b]mule cart[/b] as a constructible object in the [b]storage[/b] category of the building menu.,[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]5 new complex dish recipes[/b] to the [b]Tier 2 kitchen[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]camp model[/b] to [b]Tier 1 Table 3 (Mensa castrensis)[/b]. In the future, this table will be used to manage camp buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new building: [b]"Armor Stand"[/b] in Tier 2 [b]storage[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new building: [b]"Officer’s Armor Stand"[/b] in Tier 2 [b]storage[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new building: [b]"Officer’s Trunk"[/b] in Tier 2 [b]storage[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]CHANGES[/b] [/h2][list][*][p]Gravel can now be [b]crafted from stone[/b] at the [b]stonemason’s workbench[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rocks now always have a chance to yield gravel[/b] when broken.[/p][/*][*][p]When [b]dropping items on the ground[/b], they now [b]pile up to a limit of 30 per stack[/b], improving performance (fewer physical objects) and [b]making it easier for NPCs to work[/b] and for players to locate items without dedicated storage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mules will no longer defend the camp[/b] by default—too many casualties[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Legulus[/b] (collector) will now [b]only pick up items if storage is available[/b], and will [b]prioritize raw materials[/b] like thick grass, wicker, or straw over herbs and food.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NPCs will now loot the inventory of corpses[/b] when issued supply orders.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b] [/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that [b]disabled infinite production[/b] when manually adding items to the production queue.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where some [b]gathering tasks were canceled[/b] when using group orders.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adjusted the colors of certain map markers[/b] for better visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]performance issues[/b] affecting larger camps, such as the training camp.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: 0.3 Update Out Now! ⚔️
notes.notes:
[p][b]Salve, Centurion,[/b][/p][p][b]Update 0.3 is now live ⚔️ Roma Aeterna![/b][/p][p]This update marks a major step forward in the evolution of the game, with substantial improvements across the board: gameplay, atmosphere, narrative, and immersion.[/p][p]Here’s what you’ll find:[/p][p]🔥 [b]New Narrative Tutorial: The Camp Before the Ambush[/b]
We’ve introduced a brand-new tutorial that places you in a fully functioning Roman camp, just before the ambush. This new beginning adds a narrative twist, allowing you to better understand the world, its characters, and the core mechanics in a more vibrant and dramatic context.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555144/af31916edd2bdbe0939a5d9389e47e06b4f6c44b.gif"][/img][/p][p]🌿 [b]Visual Improvements: Nature Reimagined[/b]
We’ve redesigned vegetation, trees, and harvestable resources to create a denser, more vibrant, and more detailed world. Every expedition now feels more alive, more beautiful, and more dangerous.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555144/bb2cfd5e4730585bf66f8891861ea3a809023980.png"][/img][/p][p]🧠 [b]Smarter NPCs, More Dynamic Interactions[/b]
NPC behavior and AI have been completely overhauled. They now follow more realistic routines, react more consistently, and show greater environmental awareness — making every interaction feel more natural and immersive.[/p][p]🧭 [b]Next Phase of Interface Improvements[/b]
We’re continuing to refine the interface based on your feedback. This new phase enhances both functionality and aesthetics, delivering a smoother experience without sacrificing immersion.[/p][p]💬 [b]Thank You for Your Patience[/b]
We sincerely thank the entire community for your support and patience while we worked on this update. Your feedback and trust have been key in taking [i]Summa Expeditionis[/i] to the next level.[/p][p][b]Update 0.3.0 is now available, ready for you to dive into a new chapter in the story of Rome.[/b]
Pack your gear — what lies ahead is not just an expedition, but the beginning of something much greater.[/p][p]— [i]The Summa Expeditionis Team[/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Full Update 0.3 Patch Notes[/h3][p][b]NEW CONTENT[/b][/p][list][*][p]A training camp has been added, acting as a completely new tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Continued visual overhaul of various items and buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Two new armors have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]Canes have been added to better set the atmosphere around the lakes.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a fixed guard post at the entrance of the Tier 1 commander’s tent.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new Tier 1 production building: “Esparto Stripper” for mass esparto production.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new Tier 2 production building: “Rope Maker” for mass rope production.[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned the start game menu, campaign creation, options, and load game interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Overhauled the in-game main menu and help system.[/p][/*][*][p]All environmental decoration elements have been revamped. Forests are now denser and more proportionate, with new models for rocks, clay, salt, and decorative patches of vegetation.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized performance on systems that were suffering from bottlenecks and FPS drops even with powerful hardware.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]CHANGES[/b][/p][list][*][p]NPCs now run during work time if their destination is more than 10 meters away and they’re outside the camp’s main area.[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs now chain their tasks more efficiently, prioritizing tools they’re already holding or collecting production when no other tools are needed.[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs assigned to Faber duties now also craft items at the carpentry table.[/p][/*][*][p]Faber NPCs will now craft any items needed in production lines—for example, if a bonfire has clay vanga canteens in the queue or set to infinite, they will craft them and deliver them to the final step.[/p][/*][*][p]Some armors and helmets have been modified to be more historically accurate.[/p][/*][*][p]The idle animation has been changed[/p][/*][*][p]Faber NPCs will now also produce all required storage items for the camp—for example, if a sack storage is built and only 5 sacks exist, they’ll craft the missing ones if resources are available.[/p][/*][*][p]The HUD has been updated based on player feedback: texts, icons, and colors have been improved. Additional HUD components like radar, contubernium management, notifications, and alerts have also been completed.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]BUG FIXING[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that rendered some object storage units unusable after placing the first item—for example, sack or stone storage.[/p][/*][*][p]A bug that slowed down the game in the starting chunk has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several bugs that caused the AI to freeze, such as when dropping or crafting new items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple errors related to guard AI and guard post behavior at gates and walkways—they now execute patrol routines more reliably.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug related to item transfers between storages, which sometimes caused NPCs to store items at production output points.[/p][/*][*][p]Various general performance improvements have been added.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 0.2 now available! Tier 3, new HUD, graphic rework
notes.notes:
[h2]VERSION-0.2.0-early-access[/h2]

Centurions, I am pleased to inform you that Tier 3 has arrived. 😎

[h3]NEW FEATURES[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added a new mission at the end of Episode 8 of the main questline that grants access to your first mule cart.
[*] Added new item: “Mule Cart Platform”.
[*] Added new item: “Cart Wheel”.
[*] Added new item: “Small Mule Cart Plank”.
[*] Added new item: “Large Mule Cart Plank”.
[*] Added new item: “General Hanger”.
[*] Added new item: “Tool Hanger”.
[*] Added new item: “Torch Hanger”.
[*] Added a new episode to the main questline that brings you closer to the war zone, advances you to Tier 3, and grants a Signum (legion insignia) and a Signifer (if he survives).
[*] Tier 3 of the camp has been unlocked.
[*] Added a new “weapon”: the Legion Signum. (In the future, it will have functions for troop control, camp upgrades, and rituals. For now, it's just a very stylish spear.)
[*] A new contubernium has been added at Tier 3, bringing the total under your command to 4 contubernia (39 NPCs).
[*] Significantly improved performance in large camps to accommodate growth.
[*] Added a new, larger commander’s tent, allowing placement of the Signum next to your Vexillum (standard).
[*] Added a new, larger general tent for the camp. (It will receive storage slots and upgrades in future updates).
[*] Added a new bed.
[*] Added 2 new table models and 2 new chair models.
[*] Added a Dolia (grain silo) as a large structure to store cereals, legumes, etc.
[*] Added a new shield rack that can hold 8 shields.
[*] Added a new entrance gate.
[*] Added “Stone Path” to the “Misc” category to pave camp grounds.
[/list]

[h3]CHANGES[/h3]

[list]
[*] Updated the NPC and contubernium following system. Followers now move more naturally, avoiding panic when you move nearby and staying with you if you leave the group.
[*] War dogs and mules now have their place in formation and move accordingly instead of erratically.
[*] Revised item models, with optimizations and updated textures.
[*] Updated the human character model with improved detail.
[*] Updated the character clothing system to support all clothing layers and accessories (tunics, pants, armor, cloaks, scarves, belts, shoes, gloves, rings, earrings, necklaces…).
[*] Clothing layers can now be combined: e.g., tunic + pants + armor + cloak.
[*] Complete overhaul of armor sets with more historically accurate references:
[/list]
[olist]
[*] Light Auxiliary Armor: Now a Leather Subarmalis, a basic protection sometimes worn alone. Previously, this was a Lorica Hamata. Future versions will move this to a dedicated leatherworking station.
[*] Heavy Auxiliary Armor: Still Lorica Hamata, now redesigned to include the Leather Subarmalis underneath as a natural progression.
[*] Legionary Armor: Replaced the Lorica Segmentata (historically inaccurate for this campaign) with Lorica Hamata worn over a Wool Subarmalis.
[*] Signifer Armor: Updated to match the new armor format, including helmet and lion pelt adaptations.
[/olist]

[b]Note[/b]: All mail armor (chainmail/scalemail) is undergoing a visual style test to balance game aesthetics and historical accuracy. Further improvements are expected.

[list]
[*] Reworked all cloaks and scarves. Added a new Tesserarius Cloak.
[*] Added two new Roman tunics (yellow and white).
[*] Rebuilt all helmets with better references from this campaign’s era. Added a new Tesserarius Helmet.
[*] Reworked Cantabrian and Vascon clothing and cloaks using more accurate references.
[*] Adapted some of their helmets as well.
[*] Repainted and resized all helmets and shields to match the new character scale.
[*] Redesigned hairstyles, beards, eyebrows, and facial features for each civilization.
[*] Started redesigning the UI, with the first test focusing on the player HUD (feedback welcome):
[/list]
[olist]
[*] Top-left: Mission indicators, now styled to match the new interface.
[*] Bottom-left: Player vitals (stamina, health, hunger, thirst, sleep, and inventory load). Includes quick-view of equipped gear, drawn weapon, ammo count, and spear attack mode.
[*] Bottom-right: Contubernium panel now shows full stats for each NPC in your squad (hunger, thirst, sleep, health, and carry weight).
[*] The radar is now integrated with environmental info (date, time, season).
[/olist]

[h3]BUGS[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause the game to freeze completely during combat in some situations.
[*] Fixed various bugs that caused the AI to pause or “stare into the void” (when that happens, it’s either a bug… or an epiphany).
[*] Realigned North, South, East, and West to properly match the sun and moon cycles.
[/list]

[h2]COMING SOON[/h2]

Centurions, I don’t know how this update will feel to you—it’s the result of many new and difficult decisions, but I’ve made them from the heart, and I hope they resonate with you.

I would’ve liked to include more UI improvements, further AI upgrades, and more Tier 3 content (production buildings, structures, etc.), but now that the game has launched and I’ve been able to bring two new people onto the team, the first step was based on your feedback:

[list]
[*] Improve the UI: @Adrian has joined the team to lead this task, and he’s already fully immersed in the project. Future updates will bring not only a more beautiful interface, but one that’s far easier to use. He’s not just a talented artist—he’s also a management sim enthusiast, so I sleep better knowing this is in his hands (if I sleep at all 😅).
[*] Improve visuals and optimize: @Javi is the 3D artist behind the new style. He’s also fully committed to respecting the game’s historical look. He’s completely won me over, and I hope he’ll win you over too. We’ll continue improving visuals and performance together.
[/list]

In the coming days, we’ll announce the new Roadmap—now factoring in a growing team and greater possibilities. Here’s a preview:

[list]
[*] Continue replacing the old UI with the new, player-feedback-driven version.
[*] Keep replacing outdated 3D models with more optimized ones in the current art style (items, trees, rocks, plants, buildings…).
[*] Improve NPC AI for camp tasks, guard routines, and logistics (e.g., interacting with carts and mules).
[*] Further develop the character system (stats, traits, facial expressions, NPC free time AI, NPC training AI…).
[*] Redesign the combat system—now that we have the new character models.
[/list]

[h3]Coming very soon (almost made it into this update):[/h3]

[list]
[*] Full redesign of all animals. All dogs, cats, forest wildlife, and some new farm animals have been reworked. We didn’t have time to integrate them safely yet, but we’ll show them off soon.
[*] HUD hotkey system: We’ve designed a shortcut system accessible from the HUD to quickly drink, eat, or issue commands using F1, F2, F3… It’s been highly requested—by players and by me 😅—and it’s coming very soon.
[*] HUD indicators: We’ve added a system to show shield condition, ammo count, and other alerts directly on the player HUD.
[*] Contubernium menu: The HUD panel for your contubernium will receive updates with more info, including current orders, formation status, and total load.
[*] Hanger system: While designing the cart, we created a system for attachable hangers. You can place iron hangers on the corners of carts—these can currently be for torches, tools, or general items (boxes, wheels, etc.). The idea is to eventually allow hangers to be placed on buildings too, letting you hang tools or torches in different areas around camp. I just wanted to share it now because I think it’s going to look really cool.
[/list]

notes.title: Tier 3 Update: New date & Content
notes.notes:
Centurions!

We’re working hard on the next update, which will include the new Tier 3 Camp (more soldiers, more contubernia!), new buildings, new camps, barbarian raids, and a full questline (with surprises!).

This was the original plan, but as you know, the Summa Expeditionis team has grown with the addition of [url=https://discord.gg/HmJG3NZeb7]@Javi and @Adri[/url]. This has allowed us to expand the scope beyond what we had in mind when we announced the first [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2056200/view/4469355336712586187]Summa Expeditionis Roadmap back in November[/url].

That’s why the upcoming Tier 3 Update will also include:

[b]A completely reworked HUD[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555144/fcc7273ba6df55e84ac0cc67c1e7eb421a836f87.png[/img]

[b]A graphical upgrade[/b] for all character models, clothing, armor, and… new animal models! The bear is even scarier now. 🐻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555144/4f73b1d03edaafdab7d88b12a567f06090eeff0a.png[/img]

This increased scope means we need one more week to ensure that all the new content meets the quality you deserve.

[h2]New release date for the Tier 3 Update: March 27, 2025[/h2]

We’re confident that this extra week of patience will be worth it. 

Manuel Lobico 🐺
Creator of Summa Expeditionis

notes.title: New building! 🏛️ Update 0.1.3 now available
notes.notes:
Salve, Centurion,

The new surprise update for Summa Expeditionis has an undeniable star: the new [b]mule stable[/b]! This building will help you manage your best logistical allies. It serves as a resting point for the mules, making them easier to manage, and includes several storage slots for all items related to these animals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555144/3621d909e0f07fae9ebad91417cb987667a9a413.png[/img]

Additionally, we have added one of the most requested features by the community: clearing grass. In the buildings menu, under the "Misc" section, you will now find [b]"Clear Area"[/b]. This will mark a square of land as clearable, and both you and any soldiers assigned to the Servus Castrensis role will be able to remove the vegetation (requires the use of a shovel).

[expand type=details expanded=false]

[h2]CHANGES[/h2]

[list]
[*] The mule can now wait in place when ordered.
[*] The contents of mule storage now synchronize with its movement animations.
[*] Adjusted the mule’s walk/run distance and expanded its follow range to make its movement feel more natural.
[*] Pets no longer run while inside the camp unless they are in danger and need to flee or fight.
[*] Improved animal AI behavior in relation to their owners. They now focus better on defending their owner and will directly react to attackers during a camp attack.
[*] If a camp pet moves too far beyond the influence area (influence area x2), it will teleport back to the camp. This prevents pets from getting stuck in unreachable locations while chasing or fleeing from enemies.
[*] Revised the initial mission line to improve the ambush sequence’s aesthetics and fixed save/load issues at the start of the game. Also, expanded the initial safe zone from aggressive animals to cover the supply cart.
[*] Added a new building, [b]"Mule Stable"[/b], under the "Camp" category, where mules will prefer to stay when left free inside the camp.
[*] Added a new "building" under the "Misc" category called [b]"Clear Area"[/b], which allows players to mark areas for grass removal using a shovel. (NPCs performing servus castrensis tasks will treat this as a building and will automatically clear the area if they have a shovel available).
[*] Modified the interaction for removing mule attachments; now, you must hold the action for a few seconds. This prevents accidental unloading of all cargo.
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXING[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where enemy raids did not display their point of origin or notify players when enemies were approaching.
[*] Reviewed production settings in buildings to prevent certain rare-use items from having infinite default production.
[*] Fixed save errors that, under certain conditions, prevented the game from being saved. (This bug may reoccur as more content is added or in situations I have not been able to reproduce).
[*] Fixed issues with animal AI that caused them to wander too far from the camp, making them impossible to locate.
[*] Reviewed problems with certain texts and icons that were not displaying correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused AI to return to their original camps instead of staying in the assigned camp in certain situations.
[*] Fixed a bug where AI moved resources from one construction to another, storage, or production instead of keeping them in place.
[/list]

[/expand]

notes.title: Mules are live! 🐎 0.1.2 Update out now
notes.notes:
Salve Centurion,

Update 0.1.2 has arrived, bringing with it the long-awaited [b]mules[/b].

In a base-building game, resource transportation is essential. Mules have arrived to make life in the legion easier. This new type of domesticated animal can carry a significant amount of resources and follow you wherever you need them most.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555144/f71ded2891de3e657c2ccb55a488fd36c1f602e6.png[/img]

Mules come with 3 slots (one on their back and one on each side) where you can place specific storage items that you’ll need to craft. The storage items you can attach to your mule are:

[list]
[*] Planks
[*] Stones
[*] Sacks
[*] Minerals
[/list]

Mules also have their charming side: customize yours with collars, colorful blankets, and more accessories.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555144/9ce01cee3c8c81137e6cb47bfe7aa7b39742773b.png[/img]

There are two ways to obtain a mule for your century:

[olist]
[*] Follow the questline in a new game. We’ve modified the questline so that upon reaching tier 2, you’ll receive your first mule.
[*] Visit allied and neutral camps at tier 2. As with other pets, when you visit an allied or neutral camp, you’ll be able to recruit their pets, including their mules.
[/olist]

From the Summa Expeditionis team, we hope you enjoy the update. As always, we’re listening to your feedback both in the Steam community and on [url=https://discord.gg/HmJG3NZeb7]Discord[/url] and [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/summaexpeditionis/]Reddit[/url].

notes.title: Update 0.1.1 live now!
notes.notes:
Hello Centurion,

The first update for Summa Expeditionis is now available! With this update, we aimed to address the community feedback we’ve gathered during the game’s first month. Your ideas, concerns, and recommendations have been immensely valuable to us, and we are deeply grateful that you took the time to play, understand, and enjoy Summa Expeditionis, and to share your feedback through [url=https://discord.gg/HmJG3NZeb7]Discord[/url], [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/summaexpeditionis/]Reddit[/url], [url=https://x.com/summaexpedition]X[/url], and the Steam Community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555144/087d53c812793a7b26ab073f4bc3c3a791b6c47a.png[/img]

[expand type=details expanded=false]

[h1]0.1.1 Update[/h1]

[h2]CHANGES[/h2]

[list]
[*] The auxiliary spear in the initial equipment selection has been replaced with a pilum.
[*] Building connection points now enforce rotation to ensure alignment.
[*] Raiding Roman deserters now wear blue, matching deserter camp visuals.
[*] Legionaries and higher ranks no longer equip javelin backpacks, focusing on their melee potential.
[/list]

[h2]CONTENT[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added 9 slots to the large shelf for storing helmets up to the legionary rank and one slot for a javelin box.
[*] Added 3 slots to the medium shelf for storing molds for the forge, allowing unwanted molds to be removed.
[*] Added the ability to smelt daggers, swords, and tools in the forge.
[*]Added 3 new molds to the stonemason's table: shovel head mold, pickaxe head mold, and *securis* (axe) head mold.
[*] Added 3 new items associated with the molds.
[*]Added 3 new recipes to the armorer's table: shovel, pickaxe, and *securis* (axe).
[*] Added helmets as "repairable" items at the armorer's table.
[*] Added 8 slots to the Tier 1 weapon rack for storing javelin backpacks.
[*] Added 2 slots for bows to the Tier 1 table.
[*] Added 2 slots for quivers to the Tier 1 table.
[*] Added the recipe for the leather quiver, craftable at the Tier 1 workbench.
[*] Added the recipe for the bow, craftable at the Tier 2 armorer's table.
[*] Added a new item: "Wooden Arrow."
[*] Added the recipe for the wooden arrow to the armorer's table (currently just a stick; take advantage of the low-damage arrow offer!).
[*] Added some Kickstarter content rewards. (Check your Kickstarter inbox if you haven’t received yours).
[*] Added 5 new shields for the Cantabrian and Vascone factions.
[*] Added a new backpack: "Stone Backpack," which allows you to carry 2 stones without a speed penalty.
[*] Added an "Alarm" button to the camp management interface. This command activates all soldiers in alarm mode; they will run to equip themselves and patrol guard posts, walls, and gates. (This feature still has significant potential).
[*] The time between autosaves has been added to the game settings.
[/list]

[h2]LANGUAGES[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added Turkish to the available languages.
[*] Added Italian to the available languages.
[/list]

[h2]AI[/h2]

[list]
[*] Modified AI decision-making regarding tasks, with adjustments to manufacturing need calculations.
[*] AI now recovers up to 25% of sleep while sitting and does not consume sleep while seated. Recovery is also affected by the comfort of the seating area, similar to sleeping.
[*] Improved task queue processing.
[*] Stone workers and camp workers can now use stone backpacks during their workday.
[/list]

[h2]PERFORMANCE[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed several visual glitches: wake-up animations, work animations, and transport animations.
[*] Resolved several performance bottlenecks causing FPS drops.
[*] Improved performance when loading new areas during exploration.
[/list]

[h2]BUG FIXING[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that reset straw and wicker storages when saving and loading the game.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the AI not to defend camp boundaries, leading to frequent losses against wild animals.
[*] Fixed a bug where NPCs would unsheathe weapons and drop heavy objects even when passively in formation.
[*] Fixed a bug that turned some NPCs into "zombies" if the game was saved at the moment of their death.
[*] Fixed dismantling issues with buildings: fences and wooden stairs.
[*] Fixed a bug that did not maintain the dismantling order for buildings after loading a save.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused backpacks to fall to the ground when equipping a new backpack while already carrying one (e.g., javelin backpack, arrow quiver).
[*] Fixed several issues with AI interaction with stairs and platforms for palisades.
[/list]

[/expand]

notes.title: Gathering 🌱 Update #01
notes.notes:
Hello milites! ⚔️

First of all, thanks for the support and warm welcome to Summa Expeditionis. It has been a real pleasure to read you through [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HYmJ-MIhLLc]YouTube comments[/url], messages in our [url=https://discord.gg/9nRdDCsJWb]Discord server[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/summaexpedition]Twitter[/url] and of course, as [b]wishlists[/b] ❤️

With that said, let's get to the news. We would like to share with you the advances in the development and integration of one of the basic areas of any good survival game during the early game: gathering.

[h2]Gathering[/h2]

You will have to interact with the different resources at your disposal. Cut trees and turn them into logs or use your pickaxe to get stone, but also collect all kinds of mushrooms, branches, herbs or flowers. During the early game you won't have slaves or soldiers to do these tasks for you, so you'll need to master the different gathering mechanics to be efficient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555144/cdc4f1573afb922db9c7c07737ddf402648fdf68.gif[/img]

[h3]Stack[/h3]

Before you have a warehouse, stack your resources near the best construction zones. Plan and look for the ideal places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42555144/e09f6851bc6f0884eef94e3b7c3e4bc858ebe800.gif[/img]

We've also integrated: 
[list]
[*] Pickup and carry animations for heavier resources like logs or stones.
[*] Inventory, volume and weight of all resources.
[*] Movement speed adjustment based on inventory weight or heavy resource load.
[*] Spawn of resources, map and terrain.
[*] Start menu, legion selection and skin customization of your legionnaire
[/list]
We are also very close to integrate [b]HUNTING[/b] 🦌 which will be the theme of our next update. We'll share what animals will prowl your camp, their different behaviors and some first weapons.

It may seem like a humble first update, but be patient, it's just a first stone on the road. And you've heard before about Romans and roads 😙

If you have questions, we will try to answer the comments but the best place for it is our [url=https://discord.gg/9nRdDCsJWb]Discord server[/url].

Thanks for your support!
Stay tuned, milites ⚔️
